en.topic_title: Explainer: Hong Kong’s national security crackdown – month 73
en.topic_summary:
In July, Hong Kong’s cultural sector found itself in the crosshairs. Two independent bookstores, including one with a history of 50 years, were raided. Books were seized, and their staff members were arrested.



Greenfield Bookstore on July 30, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



The incident drew worldwide attention, sparking strong reactions from booklovers in Taiwan.



HKFP rounds up national security-related developments from the past month.







Bookstores raided, staff arrested
